description: SQL 查询、数据获取智能体。覆盖 SQL 全链路能力：自然语言转生产级 SQL、慢查询诊断与执行计划分析、索引设计与优化、数仓建模、SQL 原理深度科普、查询结果可视化。支持 MySQL / PostgreSQL / Hive / Spark SQL / ClickHouse / BigQuery 多方言。触发场景：(1) 写 SQL / 生成查询，(2) SQL 慢/优化/调优，(3) 执行计划分析 EXPLAIN，(4) 索引设计，(5) 数仓建模 / 分层设计，(6) SQL 原理问题（事务/锁/MVCC/Join算法等），(7) 表结构设计 DDL，(8) SQL 报错诊断，(9) 任何"帮我写个查询"、"这个SQL为什么慢"、"怎么建索引"类请求，(10) 查询结果可视化 / 出图 / 图表 / 数据展示。

name: sql-report-generator
description: 生产级报告生成器。将 SQL 分析结果转化为结构化报告，支持表格、矩阵、切片器、交互式组件、分页导出。内置 100+ 行业报告模板，覆盖财务、电商、制造、医疗、金融等。触发场景：生成报告、数据分析报告、Dashboard 报告、自动化报告。

name: sql-toolkit
description: SQL全链路工具集。合并自 sql-master + sql-dataviz + sql-report-generator。覆盖：自然语言→SQL生成、慢查询诊断与优化、多方言支持(SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL/Hive/ClickHouse)、50+可视化图表(PNG+交互式HTML)、生产级报告生成(100+模板)、AI洞察分析。触发场景：写SQL/优化/查数据/出图/做报告。

name: summarize-pro
description: When user asks to summarize text, articles, documents, meetings, emails, YouTube transcripts, books, PDFs, reports, conversations, or any long content. Also handles bullet points, key takeaways, action items, TL;DR, ELI5, executive summaries, chapter summaries, comparison summaries, translation summaries, thread summaries, and custom-length summaries. 20-feature AI summarizer with multiple formats, languages, and export options. All processing happens locally — NO external API calls, NO network requests, NO data sent to any server.

name: systematic-debugging
description: Four-phase systematic debugging — root cause investigation, pattern analysis, hypothesis testing, and evidence-based fix verification. Use when commands fail, scripts error, data mismatches, tools behave unexpectedly, or automation breaks. Never jump to solutions without understanding root cause. Triggers: 'debug', '报错', '排查', '哪里出问题了', '数据对不上', '脚本挂掉了', 'error', 'bug', '修复'.

name: tavily
description: AI-optimized web search using Tavily Search API. Use when you need comprehensive web research, current events lookup, domain-specific search, or AI-generated answer summaries. Tavily is optimized for LLM consumption with clean structured results, answer generation, and raw content extraction. Best for research tasks, news queries, fact-checking, and gathering authoritative sources.

name: unstructured-audit-data
description: Processing unstructured audit data (PDF scans, Word documents, compressed bid archives, images) for bid-rigging detection, document similarity analysis, and automated data extraction. Use when audit work involves (1) Batch processing compressed bid project files, (2) Scanning Word/PDF documents for restriction keywords, (3) Computing document similarity with Simhash or TF-IDF for collusion detection, (4) Batch OCR of scanned documents, (5) Extracting and analyzing price patterns from bid documents, or (6) Building automated audit data processing pipelines.

name: video-frames
description: Extract frames or short clips from videos using ffmpeg.

name: video-toolkit
description: 视频处理工具集。合并自 video-creator + video-frames。覆盖：视频创作生成、视频帧提取分析。触发场景：做视频/提取视频帧/视频分析。

name: visual-toolkit
description: 可视化工具集。合并自 illustration-analysis + scientific-illustration。覆盖：插图分析识别、顶刊级科学插图生成。触发场景：分析插图/生成科学图/期刊配图。

name: workflow-embedder
description: 审计作业流AI嵌入分析技能。分析现有审计作业流程，识别AI能力可以"无感嵌入"的节点，设计嵌入方案（触发条件、Agent调用链、输出形式）。适用于将AI从外挂式工具转变为底层基础设施，实现"日用而不知"的极致体验。适用场景：(1) 梳理某类审计项目的标准作业流程并标注AI嵌入点，(2) 新项目启动前的AI能力规划，(3) 审计系统建设的AI集成需求分析。触发词：流程嵌入、AI嵌入、无感嵌入、工作流改造、AI集成、流程优化、嵌入点分析。

name: xiucheng-self-improving-agent
description: Self-improving agent system that analyzes conversation quality, identifies improvement opportunities, and continuously optimizes response strategies.

name: zhixi-v2-enhanced
description: 智析v2.0增强版技能 - 集成RAG知识库、AI报告复核、串标检测扩展等能力
